title: db: accept xilinx flavor for VCK190 and amd-embedded for Kria (LP: #2168842)
description:
SRU of the devel MP for resolute (3.110ubuntu2.5).

Accept the xilinx kernel flavor for Xilinx Versal VCK190, and the amd-embedded flavor for Kria (LP: #2168842).

The VCK190 db entry only accepts xilinx-zynqmp, but the linux-xilinx-zynqmp meta package pulls the plain xilinx flavor (e.g. 6.8.0-1036-xilinx), so flash-kernel skips the FIT image and boot script install on kernel updates. The resolute Kria images ship linux-amd-embedded, which the Kria entry also rejects. Both entries are widened to accept those flavors.

Devel MP: https://code.launchpad.net/~sinan-k/ubuntu/+source/flash-kernel/+git/flash-kernel/+merge/512233
Test build: ppa:sinan-k/xlnx-flash-kernel (resolute).
